definitions.name: bs721_base_msg_ExecuteMsg_cosmwasm_std_results_empty_Empty_
definitions.description:
This is like Bs721ExecuteMsg but we add a Mint command for an owner
to make this stand-alone. You will likely want to remove mint and
use other control logic in any contract that inherits this.

approve.description:
Allows operator to transfer / send the token from the owner's account.
If expiration is set, then this allowance has a time/height limit

approve_all.description:
Allows operator to transfer / send any token from the owner's account.
If expiration is set, then this allowance has a time/height limit

burn.description: Burn an NFT the sender has access to

mint.description: Mint a new NFT, can only be called by the contract minter

extension.description: Any custom extension used by this contract

payment_addr.description: Payment address, is the address that will receive the payment

send_nft.description:
Send is a base message to transfer a token to a contract and trigger an action
on the receiving contract.

transfer_nft.description: Transfer is a base message to move a token to another account without triggering actions

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_binary_Binary
definitions.description:
Binary is a wrapper around Vec<u8> to add base64 de/serialization
with serde. It also adds some helper methods to help encode inline.

This is only needed as serde-json-{core,wasm} has a horrible encoding for Vec<u8>.
See also <https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/blob/main/docs/MESSAGE_TYPES.md>.

definitions.name: cw_utils_expiration_Expiration
definitions.description:
Expiration represents a point in time when some event happens.
It can compare with a BlockInfo and will return is_expired() == true
once the condition is hit (and for every block in the future)

never.description: Never will never expire. Used to express the empty variant

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_timestamp_Timestamp
cosmwasm_std_results_empty_Empty
definitions.description:
An empty struct that serves as a placeholder in different places,
such as contracts that don't set a custom message.

It is designed to be expressible in correct JSON and JSON Schema but
contains no meaningful data. Previously we used enums without cases,
but those cannot represented as valid JSON Schema (https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/issues/451)
